question: All the non-zero vectors are called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Proper vectors.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proper vectors**__

 __
 
• All the non-zero vectors are called Proper vectors.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f9eeaf3462687f98f59897e2e358e058ec2eefc03c47e9ef3cd4271ed21cb53.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Co-initial vectors**__

 __
 
• Co-initial vectors are two or more vectors that have the same initial point.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://www.vedantu.com/question-sets/61fdf574-374a-43ef-a447-a15fd4939db76573667612701884515.png] 

 
• Coplant**Coplanar vectors**__

 __
 
• Coplanar vectors are vectors that are lying on the same in a three-dimensional plane.
 
• The coplanarity of three vectors is defined when their scalar product is zero.​
 
 

dg [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cb214f613e91d4cc14b60b87a63ba0c9d4bdd2830e635bacddf7f5031a1b273.jpg] 

 
• **Equal vectors**__

 
 
• Two or more vectors are said to be equal when their magnitude is equal and also their direction is the same.
